does_not_own: domain semantics not declared by the module

value.identity_rule: Every UserModule definition has an explicit stable canonical identity.
value.path_rule: Library/storage/package path is discovery/distribution metadata, not semantic identity.
value.instance_rule: A runtime UserModule instance has its own explicit identity where multiple instances are possible.
value.type_rule: Primary UserModule type is explicit and validated.
value.version_rule: Additive evolution may preserve identity/version compatibility; breaking semantics require the owning versioning rule/new identity.
value.registry_rule: Registered definition and runtime availability/lifecycle are separate.
value.authority_rule: Module registration/visibility does not grant execution or mutation authority.
